user.title: ESPN Fantasy Hockey league
user.description: Find the league ID in your league URL (leagueId=...). The season is the year the NHL season ends (2026-27 = 2027). Private leagues also need the espn_s2 and SWID cookies from a logged-in browser session.

reauth_confirm.title: Update ESPN cookies
reauth_confirm.description: ESPN rejected the stored cookies. Paste fresh espn_s2 and SWID values from your browser.

error.invalid_auth: This league is private. Provide valid espn_s2 and SWID cookies.
error.league_not_found: No league found with that ID for that season.

abort.already_configured: This league and season is already configured.

data_description.my_team: Used for lineup alerts and as the dashboard cards' default. Automatic uses the team owned by the ESPN account whose cookies you entered.
data_description.live_interval: How often to refresh while NHL games are being played.
data_description.normal_interval: How often to refresh on game days outside games. With no games in the next day, updates are hourly.

confirm.title: Switch to season {season}
confirm.description: ESPN has renewed this league. Switch the integration to season {season}? Entities and dashboards stay the same; they start showing the new season's data.

abort.already_configured: Season {season} of this league is already set up as a separate entry. Remove one of them.
abort.entry_removed: This league is no longer configured.
